result.quote: So he covertly sent messengers to Abimelech to say, “Look, Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
result.reason: The key is a supported paraphrase of the messengers’ purpose: Zebul informed Abimelech of Gaal’s actions against him. However, “Why” also permits the materially different causal answer that Zebul sent them because he heard Gaal’s words and became angry. The question should specify whether it asks what message or warning Zebul sent.
